caption: A boy climbs a flight of stairs two at a time and reaches the top.

sa.check: A boy climbs a flight of stairs.
He takes the steps two at a time.
The climb comes first and the top is reached after.

pc.expect: Each foot lands on top of a step, not inside it.
pc.fail: A foot sinks into a step; or a foot passes through a riser; or he slides up the stairs with his feet planted.

pc.expect: Each knee lifts high and the legs alternate, and the limbs bend only at the joints.
pc.fail: Both legs lift together; or a leg bends mid-shin; or a leg stretches to reach a step.

pc.expect: His body rises with each push, his weight over the supporting foot.
pc.fail: He rises without a push; or floats up the stairs; or rises and sinks between steps.

pc.expect: The staircase keeps its number of steps.
pc.fail: Steps appear or vanish; or the staircase changes length; or the top moves away as he climbs.

pc.expect: His limbs keep their number and stay attached.
pc.fail: A limb detaches or vanishes; or a second boy appears; or he merges with the handrail.

pc.expect: His clothing and the stairwell stay the same.
pc.fail: His clothing changes colour; or the stairwell rearranges; or the steps change material.

note: Biomechanics scene: the body is the physics. Gait, posture, style and skill are not judged; only that limbs stay attached, bend at joints, keep ground contact and pass through nothing.
